_comment: Single source of truth for the q9af_corpus_check submit_job fields and runner phase caps (jobs/q9af_corpus_check/JOB_SPEC.md). A GPU-free cpu-8 job (8 physical cores, 32 GiB): rebuild job-w3c2e's 280M-token distillation mix (convert.mixdata, dev13-v1) and scan every document / window against the pinned eval-hash index (DEV + TEST + held-out), the frozen catalogs and the eval attack templates. cpu-8 is priced at $0.54 per 60 min (autor job validate, 2026-10-09). One attempt: worst case = (build 60 + 100) x $0.009.

measured._comment: w3c2e_phase_D_min: job-w3c2e's whole phase D (fetch ~3 GB + tokenise 280M tokens + DEV 13-gram filter) on its H100 box, job log 07:22:52 -> 07:27:44 UTC 2026-10-09. Laptop (24 threads, transformers 5.17.0, the Qwen3.5 tokenizer, 3.6M tokens): batch-512 tokenisation 3.41M tok/s, with the dev13-v1 contaminated() filter 2.40M tok/s. Guard (one core, 0.9M words of repo prose against the pinned 9.74M-gram index): normalise + 13-gram hash + index lookup 0.58M words/s, attack_guard 0.65M words/s, both sharing one normalise ~0.45M words/s.

estimates_not_measured._comment: cpu-8 tokenise rate = the laptop's 2.40M tok/s scaled to 8 of its 24 threads; words/token 0.8 (English web / chat / math under a 151k BPE); 6 scan workers at 70% (they share the 8 cores with the tokenizer threads); fixed overhead = DEV 13-gram set (12,104 rows) + 6 workers loading and sha-checking the 273 MB index + the analysis.

no_verdict_reason: a contamination census of job-w3c2e's training corpus (counts per class, windows, ids); the operator decides what job-w3c2e's provisional result is worth from it, and no number of this job feeds a promotion rule

submit._comment: submit_job fields not in the top-level params (jobs/common/launch.py). model is the 9B for the disk preflight only: the fetch takes the tokenizer files, never the safetensors.
submit.label: q9af_corpus_check: rebuild job-w3c2e's distillation mix (dev13-v1) and scan every window vs DEV+TEST+held-out eval hashes, frozen catalogs, attack templates (cpu-8)

context._comment: the q9af_v2 image layers (same base digest and pins: the same tokenizer stack as job-w3c2e) + code + the PRIVATE DEV rows (the dev13-v1 filter, sha256 pinned) + the pinned eval-hash index (hashes and eval run ids only, no eval text; index_sha256 2c821e29... = data/manifests/doc_overlap/index-pin.json).
